model.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals Solventless Hash Caps deliver 100 mg of pure, clean cannabis in convenient capsule form. These edible capsules are crafted using solventless extraction methods, preserving the full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes for an authentic, potent experience. Each cap offers a discreet, precise way to enjoy cannabis without smoke or vapor—perfect for those seeking consistent effects and ease of use. The solventless hash process ensures no chemical residues, just natural plant compounds working in harmony. Ideal for relaxation, relief, or simply unwinding after a long day, these capsules provide a controlled, predictable experience with every dose. Whether you're new to edibles or a seasoned enthusiast, Sweetgrass Botanicals combines quality craftsmanship with solventless purity to elevate your wellness routine.
